optional_tts_backends.description: Vendored OpenJarvis speech/TTS subset with Kokoro, OpenAI TTS, Cartesia, Whisper, Deepgram, and Faster-Whisper adapters

note: These WAV tones provide bundled UI audio cues. Spoken text output is handled by the platform TTS backend by default; tools/openjarvis_voice provides optional vendored OpenJarvis voice backends.
